checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Dark sky, lit lamps and windows.

must.item: Street and shop architecture retain shapes/positions
must.why: Layout matches; the left shopfront colour changed from green to cream/white, and the awning is now white, but the shapes are the same.

must.item: Pedestrian on right same pose and blue jacket
must.why: Same position, pose and blue jacket.
Warm glows and wet-looking road reflections are coherent.

must.item: Wide composition preserved, no new subjects/objects
must.why: No new subjects. Window contents are slightly altered.

faults.what: The shopfront colours changed (the dark green facade became cream/white) and the shop-sign text is altered.
Building details on the upper left are lost in the darkness.

summary: A convincing night version of the same street. The man is in place and the lamps and windows are lit, but the facade colours shifted and the woman on the left is still on the left pavement but small and hard to see in the dark.
